item.tib: stong gsum 'jig rten dbang ba yis / chen po stobs la sa yi bdag / mchod pa'i yang bcud gzungs kyi sde / kun 'dus nor bu 'bar ba
item.note: the colophon to the final text in this section reads as follows: ne ra brgyad gsum spang kong 'di ni / bsam yas dbu rtse nas / zhu ston dngos grub grags pa'i gter ma / rim par brgyud nas zhu g.yas rnam rgyal grags pas zhus pa'o // dge'o. the gter ston named for this final text is zhu-ston dngos-grub grags-pa. the zhu-g.yas rnam-rgyal grags-pa mentioned here was a teacher of nyi-ma rgyal-mtshan. a stone in which he left his handprint is kept at tbmc.
